parameters.name: SettingType
parameters.description:
服务配置类型。当前取值范围：
- SessionManagerDelivery：会话操作记录投递。
- InvocationDelivery：任务执行记录投递。
- AgentUpgradeConfig：云助手Agent升级配置。
- SessionManagerConfig: 云助手SessionManager配置。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs modify-cloud-assistant-settings --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --setting-type SessionManagerDelivery --oss-delivery-config EncryptionType=Inherit BucketName=example-bucket Enabled=false EncryptionAlgorithm=AES256 Prefix=sessionmanager/audit EncryptionKeyId=a80700007a70e --sls-delivery-config LogstoreName=example-logstore ProjectName=example-project Enabled=false --agent-upgrade-config '{"TimeZone":"Asia/Shanghai","BootstrapUpgrade":true,"DisableUpgrade":false,"Enabled":true,"AllowedUpgradeWindow":["02:00-03:00"]}' --resource-usage-config MemoryLimit=50MB KeepScriptFile=false CpuLimit=20 OverloadLimit=3 LogSizeLimit=10MB LogFileCountLimit=30 --session-manager-config SessionManagerEnabled=true --region cn-hangzhou
